newsitem.title: USA: Bosnia donor conference set for July 23-24.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia donor conference set for July 23-24.

text.p: Donors will meet in Brussels on July 23-24 to decide how to help Bosnia rebuild its war-torn economy, the World Bank and European Union said on Tuesday.

"The European Commission and the World Bank, as co-hosts to the Donor Conference, are convinced that there is sufficient ground to ensure that a pledging conference will provide renewed impetus to the reconstruction effort," they said in a statement.
The statement said countries and donor organizations would soon receive formal invitations to the meeting, intended to work out how to channel aid to the former Yugoslav republic.
Bosnia is also negotiating a standby loan with the International Monetary Fund. The EU said this month that it might not participate in a donor conference unless an IMF deal was struck.
International organizations say Bosnia needs billions of dollars to rebuild its economy, build new insitutions and help smooth the return of refugees.
But it has proved hard to set a date for a conference, partly because of political divisions in the country.
